fieldValues.title: 5. Spec change: the doors
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Door 1 executes a recorded ruling; Door 2 is new normative meaning (an RFC, with a Charter Check); Door 3 amends an Accepted RFC's own surface (a revision). The PR classification check also accepts 'non-normative'. Defined in srs CLAUDE.md (ruled by rfc-decision-e99a9437); every srs PR body states 'Mode · Cell · Door' and the CI check pr-classification (srs#716) reads it. Parallel issue labels in the code repos: spec change, requires-spec-rfc, rfc.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Finding 716c8ce1: the doors record was called Door 2 by its issue and Door 3 by its brief.
- Finding 157dc2a3: 11 of the last 20 merged srs PR bodies would fail the classification check.
- The check blocked a four-line CLAUDE.md PR on 2026-10-25 until a classification line was added.
- Doors classify a change to the spec, not work in general; the handbook has no stage for them.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Where do Doors sit in the handbook flow: a kind of work item, or a gate on review and merge?
fieldValues.next_action: Name the Doors in the framework as srs's local form of 'decide' (proposed).
